name: The Concrete Underneath
tag: A research terminal that tracks the power, land and equipment buildout behind AI.

scenarios.title: Track data center projects in a region
scenarios.ask: Track {projects} announced data center projects in a sample region, averaging {mw} megawatts each.
steps: Read sample permits, zoning notes and utility filings for {projects} projects.
Added up requested capacity: {=projects * mw} MW.
Estimated {=round(projects * online / 100)} projects online within 3 years based on permit stage.
Wrote a regional brief with the largest projects and open questions.
followups: How is yearly energy worked out?
Capacity in MW times 8,760 hours in a year times an assumed 80% average use, converted to gigawatt-hours. You can change the use rate.
Where does the data come from in the real terminal?
Public filings, utility interconnection queues and permit records you connect. The demo uses sample records only.

scenarios.title: Find supply chain bottlenecks
scenarios.ask: Check lead times for {items} key equipment types across {suppliers} sample suppliers.
steps: Collected sample lead times for {items} equipment types, such as transformers, switchgear and generators.
Ranked {suppliers} suppliers by quoted lead time and backlog.
Marked {=max(1, round(items * 52 / weeks * 0.3))} equipment types with lead times over {weeks}.
Summarized which items are most likely to delay projects.
followups: Large power equipment is built to order and can take a long time to deliver, so it often sets the pace of a project.
Yes. Set a threshold per item and the terminal flags any supplier quote that crosses it.

scenarios.title: Build a weekly research brief
scenarios.ask: Give me a weekly brief covering {topics} topics in about {words} words.
steps: Collected {=topics * 12} sample items on power, land, water, chips and construction.
Picked the {=topics * 2} items most likely to change project timelines.
Wrote the brief at {words} with sources listed for each claim.
followups: No. It is a research tool about the physical buildout. It does not recommend investments.
Can I add my own sources?
Yes. Add feeds, filings or saved documents, and the agents include them in the weekly pass.
